interface.name: infinity_window_style_v1
interface.description: Malaysia rounds every window it composites (ADR 0058). As in macOS, a window with a toolbar gets a larger corner than one with a plain titlebar. A client-decorated application uses this global to say which kind its toplevel is. It grants nothing, so every client may bind it. Without it, every toplevel has the titlebar corner.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Styles already set stay in place.

request.name: set_toolbar
request.description: Tells the compositor that the toplevel whose wl_surface is given draws a toolbar (a unified bar, possibly with a sidebar), so its frame gets the toolbar corner from the next frame on. It lasts for the lifetime of the wl_surface.
